subject: Request: penetration test report for renewal gating (MAP-21077)
messages:
From: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@greenleaf.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@greenleaf.com, tina.oneal@greenleaf.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for penetration test report (renewal gating)

Hi Laura,

We're in the final stage of the renewal for our enterprise agreement and procurement needs the most recent penetration testing deliverables to clear the MAP gating (MAP-21077). Can you provide the penetration test report and a remediation status summary by 2026-08-31?

Specifically, procurement has asked for:
- A copy of the pen test report (redactions are acceptable; procurement will confirm what they can accept)
- A remediation log showing open vs closed items and target dates
- Confirmation of scope (external network / customer-facing APIs / internal infra) and test dates

This is time-sensitive — procurement has a hard cutoff for contract approval next week. If you need to route to security or legal for redaction, please let us know an ETA.

Thanks,
Alex Jordan
Security Programs
Greenleaf Technologies

Attachment: procurement-checklist.xlsx (stub)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jordan <alex.jordan@greenleaf.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for penetration test report (renewal gating)

Alex — thanks for the note and the heads up on the cutoff. I'm on it.

Quick plan:
- I'll pull the latest assessment and a remediation CSV and circulate a redacted PDF for procurement review.
- Marissa (security) will confirm allowed redactions and the exact scope text to include.
- Rishi (sales) — looping you in for the MAP/contract timeline and to flag any procurement asks that require commercial sign-off.

Question for procurement: do you accept a redacted PDF + remediation log, or do you require the full unredacted artifact for your legal review? If redacted is acceptable, please confirm the types of items you need unredacted (vuln names, exploit PoC, file paths, etc.).

I'll aim to have the redacted docs to you by EOD 2026-08-27 if security confirms redaction scope; if you need unredacted we'll need a signed NDA and a short window for legal review.

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request for penetration test report (renewal gating)

Laura — tagging in the security details. Notes below cover what we can and cannot redact for procurement: 

Scope & dates:
- Assessment window: 2026-06-18 -> 2026-06-25
- Scope: external perimeter (customer-facing API endpoints), web apps behind WAF, and authentication flows. Internal-only network segments were out of scope.

Redaction policy for procurement (recommended):
- We can provide a fully redacted PDF that removes PoC exploit code, internal IPs, and verbatim exploit steps.
- We should leave vulnerability titles, severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low), affected component (e.g., public-api), and remediation status.
- Provide a separate remediation log (CSV) with ticket IDs, mitigation status, owners, and target close dates.

Remediation status snapshot (from tracker):
- 7 Critical: 5 mitigated, 2 in progress (target close 2026-09-10)
- 12 High: 9 mitigated, 3 in progress (target close 2026-09-03)
- Remaining items (Medium/Low) are owned by product teams and on routine sprints.

I'll prepare the redacted PDF + remediation CSV and an executive summary paragraph to include in the same thread. Connor, please export the remediation CSV (include ticket link column) and attach to Laura's outbound.

Marissa
Sr. Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none

Alex / procurement team — please find attached the deliverables for MAP-21077 gating:

- redwood-pen-test-redacted-2026.pdf (redacted per policy: PoC, internal IPs, full exploit steps removed)
- redwood-pt-remediation-log-2026.csv (ticket ids, owners, statuses, target close dates)
- redwood-pt-executive-summary-2026.pdf (one-page summary of scope, dates, and outstanding risk)

Executive summary (excerpt):
- Assessment window: 2026-06-18 -> 2026-06-25; scope focused on public-facing APIs and web apps.
- Key metrics: 7 Critical (5 mitigated, 2 in progress), 12 High (9 mitigated, 3 in progress).
- No issues requiring rollback or customer-impacting hotfixes. Remaining Critical items are scheduled to be closed by 2026-09-10; we will provide a follow-up status update once those two items are resolved.

If procurement requires an unredacted copy for legal review, please confirm and we will share under the standard controlled distribution (signed NDA + custodian list).

Links: HubSpot deal MAP-21077: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/21077
DocuSign link for contract (if needed): https://docusign.net/XYZ-DocSign-21077

Thanks — let me know if anything else is needed to satisfy gating.

Laura Bennett
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
